magic_shulker_boxes.title: Magic Shulker Boxes — settings
magic_shulker_boxes.help: /msb show | /msb set <option> <value> | /msb reset. Booleans: true/false. Space modes: DISABLED, MOVE_TO_BOX, DROP_AND_PICKUP.
magic_shulker_boxes.reset: Personal overrides cleared; unspecified options inherit the server defaults.
magic_shulker_boxes.locked: This server enforces its own settings. Personal changes are disabled.
magic_shulker_boxes.pickup_off: Pickup storage is off for you. Material refilling has a separate switch.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill_off: Material refilling is off for you. Pickup storage has a separate switch.
magic_shulker_boxes.invalid: Invalid setting or value. Use true/false, or DISABLED / MOVE_TO_BOX / DROP_AND_PICKUP for makeSpaceMode. Server policy cannot be changed here.
magic_shulker_boxes.save_failed: Settings could not be saved. Check the value and server log; do not assume the change was applied.
magic_shulker_boxes.reloaded: Server configuration reloaded. The policy takes effect immediately.
magic_shulker_boxes.reload_failed: Reload failed. The previous active server configuration has been kept.
magic_shulker_boxes.client_failed: Your local settings could not be read or saved. Check config/magic_shulker_boxes-client.json and the log.
magic_shulker_boxes.option.allowOtherSin: Allow other single-type boxes as fallback
magic_shulker_boxes.option.allowMixedIte: Allow mixed items when making space
magic_shulker_boxes.option.preferExistin: Reuse existing boxes before making space
magic_shulker_boxes.description.splitSta: Separate exactly one shulker from a stack into a free slot before inserting items. Supports Carpet stacking.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.allowOth: When other eligible boxes cannot accept items, allow a box containing a different single type to become a mixed box.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.useMixed: Allow boxes that already contain two or more item types.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.useEmpty: Allow opening an empty box when matching boxes cannot accept the pickup.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.local_hint: Changes this instance's singleplayer / LAN server defaults immediately. Does not change remote servers.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.allowPar: Allow partial stacks such as three stones to free a slot. When off, only stacks at their maximum size are considered.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.pickupSt: Automatically store picked-up items in carried shulker boxes; off by default. This controls pickup storage only, independently of schematic refilling. Personal settings can override the server default when allowed.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.status.UNSUPPORT: This server does not provide the settings GUI protocol. Try /msb commands.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.stale: The connection or policy changed. Reopen the settings screen.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.matchIte: Compare names, enchantments and other components when classifying boxes. Actual stack merging always compares components.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.useHotba: Allow moving hotbar items when making space. When off, only the main inventory is considered.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.busy: Requests are too frequent. Please wait and try again.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.failed: The operation did not complete. Check the log and resynchronize settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.makeSpac: When there is no free slot for a separated box: do nothing, move inventory items into it, or drop and collect them again. Direct movement is recommended.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.pickup_off: The server defaults pickup storage to off. You can enable it when personal settings are allowed.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.refill_off: The server defaults material refilling to off. You can enable it when personal settings are allowed.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.allowPla: Allow players to override these defaults, including pickup storage and material refilling independently. When off, everyone uses the shared settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.useMatch: Prefer boxes containing only the same item type as the pickup. Within each category, fill fuller boxes first.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.status.LOCKED: The server enforces shared settings. Personal preferences are locked. The local host can use World settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.missing_yacl: Install YACL 3.8.2 for Fabric 1.21.11 to use this screen. Commands and JSON settings remain available.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.includeO: Also search the offhand slot for a shulker box.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.status.OFFLINE: Edit local preferences. They apply after joining a server that allows personal settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.timeout: Confirmation timed out. Querying server settings; further saves are paused.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.recovered: Settings synchronized from the server. Reopen the editor to continue.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.recovery_unavail: Update the server mod to support reliable settings synchronization.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.server_saved_loc: Server settings are active, but the local file could not be saved. Reconnection will synchronize again.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.allowMix: Allow displaced inventory items and another pickup type to share a new box, making it a mixed box.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.onlyWhen: On: try the vanilla inventory first and store only overflow. Off: try shulker boxes before the inventory.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.invalid_file: Could not read configuration. Fix the JSON and retry; the file was not changed.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.preferEx: Try eligible existing boxes before freeing a slot for a new box, reducing unnecessary inventory changes.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.status.ALLOWED: Personal settings are allowed. Inherit follows server defaults; saves require server confirmation.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.unsaved_body: Switching pages will discard this draft. Go back to save it first.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.refillMa: If the inventory is full, move a backpack stack directly into the source box to free a slot. Never drops items; respects hotbar and partial-stack protection.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.changed: Cannot refill: source contents changed or could not be verified. Try again.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.missing: Cannot refill: no matching materials in eligible shulker boxes.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.space: Cannot refill: no safe inventory space; check space-making and stacked-box settings.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.unsupported: Cannot refill: this server needs a compatible Magic Shulker Boxes version.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.refillFu: Take up to one stack from one box slot. Off: take one item per request.
magic_shulker_boxes.refill.disabled: Cannot refill: schematic refilling is disabled.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.refillFa: Show only failed refills above the hotbar, at most once every two seconds. Successful refills are silent.
magic_shulker_boxes.description.schemati: When Easy Place lacks materials, prefer the least filled non-full shulker box. Independent of pickup storage; refill space-making may still move inventory items into the source box. Both sides need this mod. Personal settings can override the server default when allowed.
magic_shulker_boxes.gui.reset_option: Reset this option to its default
magic_shulker_boxes.option.ipnRefill: Let IPN refill from shulker boxes
magic_shulker_boxes.description.ipnRefil: When IPN cannot find a backpack replacement, offer carried backpack shulker-box contents to its own refill rules. IPN controls triggers, item matching, tool durability and sorting. Both sides need this mod; only the client needs IPN. Independent of pickup storage and schematic refilling. Respects IPN locked slots and source-box space-making settings.
